name_zh: 阿联酋·扎耶德：联邦石油宽容与女性太空火星愿景
name_en: UAE Zayed: Federation Oil Tolerance & Women Space Mars Vision
description_zh: 扎耶德·本·苏尔坦·阿勒纳哈扬 (1918-2004) 阿联酋建国总统 (1971-2004)，七酋长国联邦建立，石油财富分配免费福利，宽容政策吸引外籍人口达90%，女性权利先驱，火星探测愿景传承至子孙。
description_en: Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan (1918-2004) UAE founding President (1971-2004), seven emirates federation established, oil wealth distributed free welfare, tolerance policy attracted 90% expatriate population, women rights pioneer, Mars exploration vision inherited by descendants.
reason_zh: 扎耶德代表部落联邦如何通过石油财富与宽容政策建立现代国家，展示了女性赋权与太空愿景如何成为后石油时代国家品牌核心，其联邦模式为海湾合作提供制度蓝本。
reason_en: Zayed represents how tribal federation builds modern nation through oil wealth and tolerance policies, demonstrating how women empowerment and space vision become post-oil era national brand core, his federation model providing institutional blueprint for Gulf cooperation.
steps_zh: 研究扎耶德早年沙漠酋长与阿布扎比石油发现
分析1971年七酋长国联邦成立与石油财富分配
探讨宽容政策吸引外籍技术人才与女性权利立法
评估迪拜崛起与阿联酋火星探测器希望号发射
总结联邦石油宽容女性太空火星对后石油时代海湾国家的战略指引
steps_en: Study Zayed early desert chief and Abu Dhabi oil discovery
Analyze 1971 seven emirates federation and oil wealth distribution
Explore tolerance policy attracting expatriate talent and women rights legislation
Evaluate Dubai rise and UAE Mars Hope Probe launch
Summarize federation oil tolerance women space Mars strategic guidance for post-oil Gulf nations
expected_zh: 理解部落联邦如何通过石油再分配实现国家整合，掌握宽容与女性赋权作为后石油时代软实力的双重引擎，评估扎耶德愿景对阿联酋从石油经济向知识经济转型的决定性塑造。
expected_en: Understand how tribal federation achieves national integration through oil redistribution, grasp tolerance and women empowerment as post-oil era soft power dual engines, evaluate Zayed vision decisive shaping for UAE transition from oil to knowledge economy.
case_zh: 1918 出生；1971 联邦；2004 逝世；火星探测。联邦石油宽容女性太空火星范式永存。
case_en: 1918 birth; 1971 federation; 2004 death; Mars exploration. Federation oil tolerance women space Mars paradigm endures.
intellectual_tradition: Gulf Federal Monarchy / Post-Oil Vision / Tolerance Statecraft
cross_cultural_impact: Federation model; oil welfare; tolerance; women rights; space exploration
